column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only lesson memory of recipe DOC_BANNER_OPENER: one row per lesson, appended in the same commit as the correction.

column4: A license banner whose line 1 is "/" plus only asterisks opens a doc comment; doclint reports dc.unexpected.comment before package and -Werror fails the JDK build. Change only the opener "/**" to "/* " (same length) where line 2 is a Synexia copyright line, and fix the generators that emit the banner (ARRAY_MAP.java.tmpl, stale-contracts apply.py HEADER) in the same commit.

The same banner can follow leading // comment lines (an SPDX line); v1 only looked at line 1 and missed it (jdk.m3.collections packed/PackedUnsignedLongVector.java from #2902 still failed doclint). The banner line is now the first line after leading // lines; the rule and the one-byte change are unchanged.
